three Mechanical Turk workers carefully annotated factual errors

In earlier work, we developed a protocol where three Mechanical Turk workers (who had been screened and passed a qualifying test) carefully annotated factual errors in a text produced by a neural NLG system.
The same three annotators marked up all 90 texts.
guideline: Each mistake was characterised by its position in the text and a category.

Annotators were instructed to identify factual errors, mark their span (start and end token) and assign one of the predefined categories (Incorrect number, Incorrect name, Incorrect word, Context error, Not checkable, Other).

Annotators were asked to identify factual errors in the text using a defined protocol with categories such as Incorrect number, Incorrect name, Incorrect word, Context error, Not checkable, and Other.
